raw_text: IT EN DE MENU HOME / PROPERTIES / VILLA SORRISO - BRASILE FOR SALE · VILLA Villa Sorriso - Brasile NATAL PRICE €270,000 Photos (48) Floor plans (0) 1 / 48 FLOOR AREA 345 m² BEDROOMS 4 BATHROOMS 6 LIFT No ENERGY CLASS In definizione Overview We present a real estate opportunity just a few meters from the famous Ponta Negra beach, an icon and postcard of the city. Designed both as a prestigious residence for those seeking a superior quality of life, and as a high-yield investment for the tourist and rental market. Its spaces, flooded with light and caressed by ocean breezes, unfold in a continuous and harmonious flow. The living area is truly a stage for conviviality, a generous space to welcome guests and share precious moments. The kitchen, conceived as the beating heart of the home, combines practicality with style. Beyond the representative area, the house reveals its more intimate side: reserved and quiet rooms designed to offer privacy. Outside, versatile space opens up to your aspirations, ready to transform into a tropical garden or an oasis with private pool. What makes this property a unique investment is its privileged location. It stands at very short distance from the legendary Ponta Negra beach—the undisputed symbol of the region—but on a quiet street sheltered from bustle. Immediate proximity to exclusive services and direct access to the famous Rota do Sol—the gateway to some of the most enchanting beaches in the state—gives this property strategic value that transcends time. Whether it’s your personal retreat or an opportunity for high-profile income generation, this house awaits only for its next chapter to begin.
